## Verification and limitations

<!--
Identify the tested revision and relevant platform, compiler, and build options;
a CI link that identifies these is sufficient. List checks actually run and
their results. For a bug fix, show failure before and success after the change,
or explain why that comparison is unavailable and propose another check.

For documentation changes, describe the accuracy, rendering, or link checks
performed; explain if a build is unnecessary. Disclose untested configurations,
unrelated failures, compatibility concerns, and remaining work. Explicitly flag
disabled tests, weaker assertions, tolerated failures, or changed expected output.
-->

The human PR author is responsible by default. If another person owns the work,

State "No material AI assistance" or identify the tool and what it contributed

## Before requesting intake

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff, can explain the change, and will address review feedback.
- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/HDFGroup/hdf5/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I added applicable tests, documentation, and `release_docs/CHANGELOG.md` entries, or explained any omission above for maintainer consideration.
